payload.name: Ghostly Warning
payload.description: A translucent figure materializes before you. It points deeper into the dungeon and whispers...

success.description: The ghost reveals the location of traps and enemies ahead.

failure.description: The ghost's whispers are incomprehensible. It fades away.

success.description: The ghost bows and dissipates. A gold coin materializes where it stood.

failure.description: The ghost shrieks in anger. You feel a cold chill!
